messages:
alex: Quick question about streaming deltas for chat/completions — can we include partial function_call params in intermediate delta events, or should we only emit them on the final chunk?
priya: Prefer final-only for compatibility with older SDKs, but partials are useful for UX. is there a backwards-compatibility flag we can gate on?
sam: SDK v1.4 currently expects `function_call` only in final message. If we emit partials we need to bump parsing logic and add a feature flag.
maria: @alex @priya fwiw the PR I started (links removed for thread) proposes `stream_chunk.type = "delta" | "final"` plus optional `function_call_partial` for deltas. That would be opt-in.
alex: can you paste a minimal example of the payload shape you'd want for a partial?
maria: sure — example below: ```json
{"type":"delta","delta_id":42,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"...","function_call_partial":{"name":"lookup_user","args_fragment":"{\"user_id\": \"123\"}"}}}
```
alex: ok, so delta contains `function_call_partial.args_fragment` (string) which clients stitch. How do we ensure ordering and reassembly?
priya: include `delta_id` + `is_last_fragment` on partials. final chunk has `type: "final"` and full `function_call` object.
sam: tests we need: 1) older SDK ignores `function_call_partial` without breaking 2) new SDK reassembles fragments and emits function call when complete 3) fallback when fragments missing (timeout -> ignore). I'll add unit tests.
ci-bot: build passed on branch api/streaming-func-partial (cwd: infra/streaming) :white_check_mark:
maria: implemented delta_id + fragment_index + is_last_fragment in the branch. Also added a quick doc blurb in API contract md.
alex: pinging @maria for a quick CR on error handling edgecases — specifically, what happens if partials arrive out of order?
maria: plan: include `fragment_index` and let client reorder; server will still emit final `function_call` only when `is_last_fragment` seen, otherwise after timeout we emit `final` without function call and post an `incomplete_function_call` warning in `meta`.
priya: can we avoid adding `meta` fields that break strict schemas? maybe add `warnings: []` array on final to keep shape stable.
sam: agreed — warnings array is safer. Add one warning code `FUNC_PARTIAL_INCOMPLETE`.
alex: sounds good. next steps: maria opens PR to main with tests + doc, sam adds SDK parser changes, priya updates contract md. I'll put a small canary rollout flag behind `enable_streaming_func_partials` for two weeks. :thumbsup:
maria: will do, PR link in a bit. thanks all.
alex: thanks — moving to async, will follow up if any blockers show up.
